note: [M]'s forward unit differences are the case back=0, fore=1 of `Reach` intervals, so [L] covers more difference operators and adds locally uniform convergence; the limit f is the same for all l and the family is the constructed one.

snippet.text:
def PositionsUV (C : Family G) (e : Extraction.Sequence) :=
  ∀ (p n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token),
   ∃ f : Points n → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (NoHit C.S p n) ∧
     (∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t → Tendsto (fun j => Order.smears C (e j) p v t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo f))) ∧
     ∀ l : List (Reach n),
       let F N := squall (C.S.a N) l (lifted C N p v)
       let g := derive f (l.map Reach.where_)
       Cluster C e p n F g ∧
       Meets (NoHit C.S p n) (fun j => interpolated C.S (e j) (F (e j))) g ∧
       ∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t →
         Integrable (fun x : Points n => t x * g x) ∧
         Tendsto (fun j => sumOn F C.S p (e j) t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo g))

proof_context.conclusion: For all p, n, v there is f smooth on `NoHit` such that for every list l of `Reach` differences the smeared lattice sums `sumOn F` converge to the integral of the test times `derive f` for every suitable test, with `t*g` integrable.
`fullMesh` states `PositionsUV` for the constructed family along the full mesh sequence.
